description: Utility functions for token management, including generating safe user copies, creating tokens, encryption/decryption, and validation based on expiry times.

methods.name: generateSafeCopy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a user object without sensitive fields like credentials, tokens, and optionally email.

methods.name: generateTempToken
methods.description: Generates a temporary token using nanoid.

methods.name: encryptToken
methods.description: Encrypts a string using AES-256-CBC with a secret hash and a random IV.

methods.name: decryptToken
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted token string back to plaintext.

methods.name: getUserUUIDFromToken
methods.description: Extracts user UUID from a decrypted token string.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is still valid based on its expiry time and type.
